links.reason: Both have the woman test a broken promise (பிரியலம் என்ற சொல், அளித்தஞ்சல் என்றவர்), but the Kural's தேறியார்க்கு உண்டோ தவறு asks who is at fault while மறந்தனர் கொல்லோ asks only about memory; the 'already assumed' claim is generous and the pairing is mostly shared situation.

290 names only the minister's treachery and calls the king அறச் செங்கோல், so nothing in the verse shows 548's neglect (எண்பதத்தான் ஓரா முறைசெய்யா); the 'neglect opens the door' mechanism comes from 261, not this unit, and a murdered just king is not தானே கெடும்.

878 (சுண்ணந் தோற்றனந் ... பொன்னீதும்) does spell out the patikam's vow (இந்நீர்ப் படியேம் இவை தோற்றனம்) with the gold stake, so the link is real; but that only the honour half is followed through the story is not shown by either verse.

1215 has the god foretell the king's gift of his daughter; 1296's crowd says கொடுக்கு மென்பார் but as guesses beside other guesses (விஞ்சையர் வீரன், விண்ணவர் குமரன்), not drawn from the prophecy, so 'foreknowledge passes from the divine to the public' is invented.

1373 (துஞ்சலோம்புமின் எனவும் துஞ்சினீர்) shows eyes that slept, the reverse of 1179's வாராக்கால் துஞ்சா வரின்துஞ்சா; the couplet itself gives no watch-against-loss motive, that comes from commentary, and it does not 'fear' a lapse.

The river-as-கணிகை and 916's புன்னலம் பாரிப்பார் share the courtesan figure, but 'with approval' and the deliberate reversal are not in 1200's words; the simile may simply mean the river takes gems, so the lesson about where the Kural's contempt lies is read in.

The verse's அரசனிற் சுருங்கி uses an unjust king's shrinking as a yardstick, which resembles 553's நாடொறும் நாடு கெடும் only loosely, and one flagged-uncertain simile cannot show the rule was 'assumed outside moral discourse'.
links.text_issue: Sense flagged uncertain; the simile's grammar is unclear.

links.reason: 170's வெல்வதற்கரிது ஆல் வினையின் பயன் against Saiva burning of karma is a real contrast in doctrine, but 120 says nothing of a teacher or grace in its words (தீமேவு ... எரி சார்ந்த), and its obscure ஆமேவு opening makes the seed reading uncertain.
links.text_issue: Tirumanthiram 120 is obscure; fire-touched seeds is a reading.

links.reason: 2015 sorts தியானம் by fruit (நால் வகை, இரண்டு தீது) and 598 lists objects (சத்தி, பரம், சிவம்) as parts of yoga; these are not incompatible claims, and the verse 598 reading is itself uncertain, so the pairing is only shared topic.

2099's king gives the army and earth to his sons and removes the crown while Naladiyar 21 says even umbrella-kings are துஞ்சினார் என்றெடுத்துத் தூற்றப்பட்டார்; the contrast of voluntary leaving against death is real but generic, and renunciation does not 'qualify' death's reach.

438 says the herdsmen cry படையுடைந் திட்டது and Kattiyangaran sinks in grief, not that the herd is lost; 455's வெகுண்டான் is unnamed, so tying rage to a rival's glory is reconstruction, and grief then rage is not a clash of claims.
links.text_issue: 455 flagged uncertain; the raging man is unnamed.

links.reason: Both end a sulk with sweetness (இடனறிந் தூடி இனிதின் உணரும், நகைமுக வமுதம் ஈந்தாள்), but 'a joke at her own expense' is not in the verse, whose line 1 is obscure; nothing shows the epic softening the quatrain's ideal.
1666 has the king say அஞ்சல் and 1667 shows him turn the elephant back (மறித்து), which is adjacent plot sequence; 'the rescuer sent the danger' and 'completes his ruse' appear in neither verse.
1649's வரை மேகலை மாறே ... சிலம்பும் and 1650's மணிமழலை ... எதிர் மிழற்றும் அசதியாடின்று do show echo turning from metal to speech and mockery; real but a minor progression within one description.

66 vows to wreck Ujjain and recover the king with the king's daughter (மன்மகளுடன் கொற்றவனை மீட்குவம்); 219 gives two other brides, but neither verse says the vow was dropped, so 'replaced by a bond of kin' is reconstructed.
இன்ன காணென (786) and இதுகாண் (800) share a pointing formula in a tour, but one verse does not answer or fulfil the other; this is a repeated pattern across sequence.

2035 says only that he hums on the couch to bring on the wedding; it has no old brahmin, no begging and no worship of her feet, and 899's நோற்பன் நோற்றனை நீ is uncertain, so 'vow kept in form, defeated in substance' is built from other verses.

1081 leaves the doubt among அணங்கு, மயில், மாதர் with no test, while 644 asks என் அரம்பை என்னா ஆறு then இமைக்குங்கண் இவையோ, the blink that marks a mortal; the epic adds a specific test the couplet lacks, and the note describes both accurately.

கொற்றவன் குறிப்பு நோக்கி closely matches குறிப்பறிந்து and கற்றநூற் புலமை ... காட்டுதல் கருதி is a real added motive; but 'something the king will welcome' is not in this verse and the timing clause is thin.

192 only reports the brahmins (நன்றது என்றனர் அந்தணர்) and the verse ends with others reciting நீதிகள், so the epic does not itself judge the eating meritorious; 'heaven for the dead' is not stated, and the epic's own stance may match Tirumular's.

109 (வஞ்சந் தன்னை உற்று சூள் வழாமை நோக்கி) has Yugi deceive to keep a vow, while 660 condemns சலத்தால் பொருள்செய்து; the limit-case idea is real, but the verse passes no verdict and the couplet is about wealth.

Both set a victim at the killing ground (கொலைக்களம், வெறியயர் வெங்களம்) and a smile: Naladiyar's lamb nibbles the garland unknowing, while 59's youths குலுங்கலர் ... மலக்கிலா மனத்தர் smile; the contrast of ignorance and composure is specific and the note describes both correctly.

The protected list (பசு, பெண்டிர், துறந்தார், பார்ப்பார்) matches 243's ஆவையும் பாவையும் அறவோரையும், and the shift from hell to பேடி shame is a real difference; but 'failed king' and 'office failing' are not in either verse.
The king's புணர்ந்து நீங்கும் பெண்ணியல் is about women's ties parting, whereas 362 says guarded women still இழுக்கு; these differ, and 'a husband who has seen guarding fail' is not in 128.

561's புறஞ்சொல் வாராத் தன்மையால் உலகங் காத்தார் is blamelessness by descent, while 388 makes இறை conditional on முறைசெய்து காப்பாற்றும்; that the boast is a debt repaid each reign is the grader-note's own moral.

620's சீறிற் றேந்துணர் வின்றிச் செகுத்திடும் king and 1149's அனன்றனன் ... சனங்களைத் திரட்டிப் பின்னை தக்கது அறிவன் is a fair qualification of a portrait, but 620 does not name the king, so identity with this speaker is reconstructed.
Naladiyar 23's wedding drums turn to பிணப்பறை; 1107 has no such reversal, only some leaving for forest and some wondering (கனவினும்), and does not say the wedding moved them; no incompatible claim.

983 shows him slip between the tusks (கொம்மை, மருப்பிடைக் குளித்து) and drive the beast off; 1834 has only patting (கொட்டலும்) and the elephant doing its trained tasks, not mounting or harnessing as the note says.

1443's கருடனும் உழையன் ஆனான் makes Garuda an attendant, not a mount, so the note and 'ride and shoot' misdescribe the unit; 1452's weapon in உவணப் புள்ளின் உருவு is a different thing from the living bird.

249's ஊழ் வர அன்னதேனும் ... சூழ்ச்சியுள் தோன்றும் does not say counsel softens fate, and 101's பழவினை seeks its doer like a calf, so they need not differ; the gains clause even makes counsel the old deed's route.

139's மன்னுயிர்க்கு அரண மன்னவர் refuses a life to save his own, and 191's கொன்று வந்து ஏற்றினான் ... எருமைப் பலி has the next king do the reverse; the reversal is specific, though the father-son tie is not stated in either verse.

107's astrologer says a Vidyadhara king will come and give a daughter (தன்மகளொருத்தி தன்னைத் தந்தனன்); 515 fulfils it by letter (வழங்கப் பட்டாள்), not in person, which is a real shift; the closing 'answering and choosing' is only a hope.
links.text_issue: 515 flagged uncertain; who gives and takes in line 4 unclear.

links.reason: Both say a small gift grows great (குன்றுபோற் கூடும் பயன், வான்சிறிதாப் போர்த்துவிடும்), but one makes the cause the giver's melted heart (உள்நெகிழ்ந்து ஈயின்) and the other the worthy receiver (தக்கார்கைப் பட்டக்கால்); the pair shows two conditions on the same claim.

137 brings the queen to the minister's house and 138 has him ask her a boon, adjacent plot; that she was brought 'to be asked for consent' is not in 137, which says only that he bows and speaks gently.
2067's நாளை ... சேரேனாய்விடிற் செல்க is kept in 2078's நங்கையை நல்கினான், a real fulfilment; but 'secret' union made lawful by kin is not in either verse, and the oath wording is uncertain.
668's விதியினை விலக்க மாட்டா is a king's fatalist speech, not a scene, and 2030's விதியின் பெருவலி வேலைசூழ் வையம் is obscure; the pairing rests on the word விதி and a generous reading.

1245's மூன்று கடிமதிலுங் கட்டழித்த names the tripura deed for the Jina, but the verse never says the forts are inner bonds, which 343's மும்மல காரியம் does, so 'both read it as inner bonds' is unsupported.

ஆர்வ வேரரிந்து and ஆசை வேரை அடிஊடறுப்பது share the root-of-desire image, with the epic completed and the Siddhar's still a longing; neither extends the other, so this is same_image, though the order cut, austerity, release is a useful contrast.
1024 calls desire காம வெந்தழல் and has him மெலியலுற்றான், so the epic does not approve it, and 204's வெய்து கொள்ளீர் warning is closer to agreement than to a clash; the epic makes no counter-claim.

247 has king and minister both act on what the learned say (தெரிந்து சொன்னால் ... செய்யும்), while 638's அறிகொன்று அறியான் எனினும் உழையிருந்தான் கூறல் கடன் concerns a king who will not heed; the epic has no refusing king, so the gains clause is false.

Akananuru's offence is a real marriage (வதுவை அயர்ந்தனை என்ப) while 1311's is only கண்ணின் பொதுஉண்பர், so 'been with other women' overstates the Kural, and the couplet as 'end point of the scene' is unsupported.

101's வினைகள் தீர யோகத்தைக் காத்து and 122's தவயோகத்துள் புக்கு ... அவன்பதி போக both describe effortful yoga; Nandi 'gave' the teaching (நமக்களித்தான்), not the abode, so the grace-against-effort clash is not in the words.

147's decayed house keeps a dry corner (பெய்யா ஒருசிறை) while 60's proverb about a hall cut into (அறுப்பினும் மன்று) is obscure; the shared 'damaged building keeps its use' rests on the note's own uncertain reading of என்றூடு.

1320's நிகருனக் காகி தொலைவிடத் தல்லாற் is a taunt, and 1325 shows a fighter fall while kings ask தோற்குமோ ஒருவனுக்கு; the fallen man is not named in 1325, so the fulfilment rests on inference, and the 'teaches' is only plot.
